meta.name: Mine pharma complaint trends and trigger CAPA alerts with Claude and Slack

parameters.content:
## Pharma Product Complaint Intelligence Miner

Pulls in raw product-quality complaints, uses Claude to extract structured defect signals (product, batch, defect type, severity) from free-text narratives, clusters recurring defect patterns, compares each cluster's volume against its own rolling baseline, and automatically escalates any cluster that is statistically unusual - not just individually severe complaints.

### How it works
1. A scheduled poll fetches newly logged complaints since the last run; a Manual Trigger lets you test on demand.
2. HTTP - Fetch New Complaints pulls raw complaint records. JS - Normalize Complaint Records reshapes them into one schema and drops anything already processed (tracked in workflow static data).
3. If there are no new complaints, the cycle ends immediately - no AI call, no noise.
4. Claude extracts structured fields from each complaint's free-text narrative: product, batch/lot, defect category, and a severity assessment.
5. JS - Cluster by Product & Defect Category groups the structured complaints into defect-pattern clusters for this cycle.
6. JS - Compare Clusters Against Rolling Baseline is a deterministic, non-AI check: each cluster's count is compared against its own historical rolling average (z-score), completely independent of any AI judgment, so a single mis-extraction can never suppress a real statistical spike.
7. A Switch routes statistically unusual clusters to an immediate quality escalation (CAPA-track ticket + Slack alert); ordinary clusters are simply logged to the trend store.
8. The rolling baseline store is updated so next cycle's comparison has fresh history.

### Customization
- Adjust the z-score threshold in Set - Config to tune sensitivity to volume spikes vs noise.
- Change what counts as a 'cluster key' (currently product + defect category) in JS - Cluster by Product & Defect Category to also split by batch/lot if you need finer-grained trending.
- Add a weekly digest of all logged (non-escalated) clusters for periodic quality review.

## Stage 1: Discovery & Structured Extraction

- **Schedule Trigger - Poll Complaint Source** — polls on a schedule (default daily) to start each mining cycle.
- **Manual Trigger - Test Run** — lets you run the whole workflow on demand for testing.
- **Set - Config** — central place for the complaint source, baseline settings, ticketing, and Slack channels.
- **HTTP - Fetch New Complaints** — pulls newly logged complaint records since the last run. 🔑
- **JS - Normalize Complaint Records** — reshapes raw complaints into one schema and drops ones already processed.
- **IF - New Complaints Found?** — branches to AI extraction if anything new was found, else ends the cycle.
- **No Action - End Cycle** — ends the run with no AI call when there are no new complaints.

## Stage 2: AI Extraction & Deterministic Clustering

- **JS - Fan Out Complaints for Extraction** — splits the normalized complaints into one item per complaint for individual processing.
- **Anthropic - Complaint Extraction Model** — the Claude model used by the extraction agent. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Extract Structured Complaint Fields** — pulls product, batch/lot, defect category, and severity out of each free-text narrative.
- **JS - Parse Extracted Fields** — safely parses Claude's structured output, defaulting to 'uncategorized' if parsing fails.
- **JS - Cluster by Product & Defect Category** — groups this cycle's structured complaints into defect-pattern clusters.
- **JS - Compare Clusters Against Rolling Baseline** — deterministically flags clusters whose volume is a statistical outlier vs their own history, independent of the AI.

## Stage 3: Escalation & Trend Logging

- **JS - Fan Out Clusters for Routing** — splits the clustered results into one item per cluster for individual routing.
- **Switch - Route by Statistical Anomaly** — routes statistically unusual clusters to escalation, ordinary ones straight to logging.
- **HTTP - Create CAPA Quality Escalation** — opens a CAPA-track quality ticket for the unusual cluster. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert Quality Team (Cluster Escalation)** — posts an immediate alert with the cluster's defect pattern and z-score. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Escalation & Routine Paths** — merges the escalated and routine clusters back into one flow.
- **HTTP - Log Cluster to Trend Store** — records every cluster's volume and outcome for the rolling baseline and future trend analysis. 🔑
